nina: FYI build broke on staging after we merged the guide reorg. MkDocs is yelling about duplicate HTML fragment IDs but the source headings are in different files (one is an included snippet). docs-bot: build error: Duplicate ID found: 'quickstart-setup' in 'site/guides/quickstart/index.html' and 'site/guides/shared/snippets/setup.html' ben: Ah, this is the include/partials case: we include the same heading block in two pages, slug generation doesn't namespace includes. oliver: We hit this when moving shared snippets into docs/_includes/ and then referencing them from multiple pages. MkDocs doesn't dedupe heading IDs across final site output. kate: Quick mitigation: remove the top-level heading from the snippet and let the parent page supply the H1/H2. But that requires editing lots of snippets. nina: Alternative: add a small HTML id override on the snippet heading, e.g., `### Setup ` or use `{% raw %}

Setup

{% endraw %}` in the include. Not pretty but surgical. ben: We could also enable the mkdocs plugin `markdown-include` option to strip heading IDs, or run a postrender step that uniquifies IDs. Both are heavier changes. oliver: For now I opened PR #4217 that removes the H3 from the shared snippet and documents the pattern in docs/STYLEGUIDE.md. Local `mkdocs build` now clean on my machine. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4217 docs-bot: preview deploy: https://preview.deploy/1759994444-4217 no duplicate-id warnings kate: Can we add a CI lint to detect reused snippets with their own headings? Maybe a tiny grep that searches `_includes/` for leading heading tokens (e.g., `^#{1,6}\s`) and fails if present. ben: I'll add `scripts/check_includes_no_headings.sh` that runs in the docs CI job. Keeps things simple without changing mkdocs config. nina: Also found a related link issue: some internal anchors used `%20`-encoded spaces from a copy-paste. Fixed a couple of links in the PR (replaced with `#how-to-configure`-style anchors). oliver: Good catch. Those encoded anchors are brittle across static site generators. kate: Once CI is green let's merge. Also add a short note in the migration checklist: "Shared includes should not contain top-level headings; use explicit ids if unavoidable." ben: pushed the include-clean check and updated the workflow. PR updated. nina: Merging after CI :shipit: docs-bot: pull request merged by nina commit ef4c9b7 (1759994499) kate: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a small automation to scan for URL-encoded anchors in incoming PRs. :sparkles:
